title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: share a chat session or a single response by link
summary: Pass with minor corrections: the default, tenant-wide switch, sharing behaviour and rollout facts are supported. The licensing field should name the published product-level requirement, the checklist refers to controls missing from its table, and unattributed prose uses the former product name.

claims.claim: The briefing calls the product Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot is now named Microsoft Copilot, and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is now named Microsoft Copilot Chat.
claims.fix: Use 'Microsoft Copilot' in the title and unattributed running prose; retain the original name when reporting the roadmap record or MC1461700.

claims.quote: Session sharing lets users share an entire Copilot conversation, including all prompts and responses.

claims.claim: Response sharing includes a single response and the prompt that generated it.
claims.quote: Response sharing lets users share a single Copilot response along with the prompt that generated it.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes shared content as opening in a read-only view.
claims.quote: The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat.

claims.claim: The roadmap says recipients can continue from shared content in their own Copilot chat.

claims.claim: MC1461700 says messages added after sharing remain private and are not included in the shared session.
claims.quote: Session sharing captures only the conversation content available at the time the link is created. Messages added after sharing remain private and are not included in the shared session.

claims.quote: Updates from the original sharer don't appear in your copy.

claims.claim: No UI or API for scoping session and response sharing to specific users or groups is documented.

claims.claim: The tenant switch is the only documented admin control specific to this sharing feature.
